note: Only the heart and its adjoining vessels are taken from the cardiovascular export. The same repository bundles Kidney (CC BY-NC 4.0), Anatomy of the Inner Ear (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and Brainder / White matter (licence not stated); none of those pieces is used. Every node below is a Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D structure.

parts.name: Right atrium
parts.zhDesc: 接受來自上腔靜脈、下腔靜脈與冠狀竇的缺氧血，經右房室瓣（三尖瓣）流入右心室。
parts.enDesc: Receives deoxygenated blood from the superior and inferior venae cavae and the coronary sinus and passes it through the right atrioventricular (tricuspid) valve into the right ventricle.

parts.name: Right ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 將缺氧血經肺動脈瓣射入肺動脈幹；腔內有乳頭肌，並以腱索連接右房室瓣。
parts.enDesc: Pumps deoxygenated blood through the pulmonary valve into the pulmonary trunk; its cavity contains papillary muscles linked to the right atrioventricular valve by chordae tendineae.

parts.name: Left atrium
parts.zhDesc: 接受四條肺靜脈的充氧血，經左房室瓣（二尖瓣）流入左心室。
parts.enDesc: Receives oxygenated blood from the four pulmonary veins and passes it through the left atrioventricular (mitral) valve into the left ventricle.

parts.name: Left ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 將充氧血經主動脈瓣射入升主動脈；心壁在四個心腔中最厚。
parts.enDesc: Pumps oxygenated blood through the aortic valve into the ascending aorta; its wall is the thickest of the four chambers.

parts.node: Anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle
parts.name: Anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 右心室最大的乳頭肌，以腱索連至右房室瓣的尖瓣。
parts.enDesc: The largest papillary muscle of the right ventricle; its chordae tendineae attach to leaflets of the right atrioventricular valve.

parts.node: Inferior papillary muscle of right ventricle
parts.name: Inferior papillary muscle of right ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 位於右心室下壁，以腱索連至右房室瓣的尖瓣。
parts.enDesc: Arises from the inferior wall of the right ventricle; its chordae tendineae attach to leaflets of the right atrioventricular valve.

parts.node: Septal papillary muscle of right ventricle
parts.name: Septal papillary muscle of right ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 起自室間隔的右側面，以腱索連至右房室瓣的尖瓣。
parts.enDesc: Arises from the right side of the interventricular septum; its chordae tendineae attach to leaflets of the right atrioventricular valve.

parts.node: Inferior papillary muscle of left ventricle
parts.name: Inferior papillary muscle of left ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 位於左心室下壁，以腱索連至左房室瓣（二尖瓣）。
parts.enDesc: Arises from the inferior wall of the left ventricle; its chordae tendineae attach to the left atrioventricular (mitral) valve.

parts.node: Inferior leaflet of right atrioventricular valve
parts.name: Inferior leaflet of right atrioventricular valve
parts.zhDesc: 右房室瓣（三尖瓣）的尖瓣之一；模型中連同其腱索一併呈現。
parts.enDesc: One of the leaflets of the right atrioventricular (tricuspid) valve; the model includes its chordae tendineae.

parts.node: Septal leaflet of right atrioventricular valve
parts.name: Septal leaflet of right atrioventricular valve
parts.zhDesc: 右房室瓣（三尖瓣）靠近室間隔的尖瓣；模型中連同其腱索一併呈現。
parts.enDesc: The leaflet of the right atrioventricular (tricuspid) valve next to the interventricular septum; the model includes its chordae tendineae.

parts.node: Posterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve
parts.name: Posterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve
parts.zhDesc: 左房室瓣（二尖瓣）的後尖；模型中連同其腱索一併呈現。
parts.enDesc: The posterior leaflet of the left atrioventricular (mitral) valve; the model includes its chordae tendineae.

parts.name: Left coronary leaflet of aortic valve
parts.zh: 主動脈瓣左冠狀動脈瓣
parts.zhDesc: 主動脈瓣的半月瓣之一，對應左冠狀竇，左冠狀動脈由此發出。
parts.enDesc: A semilunar cusp of the aortic valve facing the left aortic sinus, from which the left coronary artery arises.

parts.name: Right coronary leaflet of aortic valve
parts.zh: 主動脈瓣右冠狀動脈瓣
parts.zhDesc: 主動脈瓣的半月瓣之一，對應右冠狀竇，右冠狀動脈由此發出。
parts.enDesc: A semilunar cusp of the aortic valve facing the right aortic sinus, from which the right coronary artery arises.

parts.name: Non-coronary leaflet of aortic valve
parts.zh: 主動脈瓣無冠狀動脈瓣
parts.zhDesc: 主動脈瓣的半月瓣之一，對應沒有冠狀動脈發出的後竇。
parts.enDesc: The semilunar cusp of the aortic valve facing the posterior sinus, from which no coronary artery arises.

parts.node: Anterior semilunar leaflet of pulmonary valve
parts.name: Anterior semilunar cusp of pulmonary valve
parts.zhDesc: 肺動脈瓣的三片半月瓣之一，位於前方。
parts.enDesc: One of the three semilunar cusps of the pulmonary valve, lying anteriorly.

parts.node: Left semilunar leaflet of pulmonary valve
parts.name: Left semilunar cusp of pulmonary valve
parts.zhDesc: 肺動脈瓣的三片半月瓣之一，位於左側。
parts.enDesc: One of the three semilunar cusps of the pulmonary valve, lying on the left.

parts.node: Right semilunar leaflet of pulmonary valve
parts.name: Right semilunar cusp of pulmonary valve
parts.zhDesc: 肺動脈瓣的三片半月瓣之一，位於右側。
parts.enDesc: One of the three semilunar cusps of the pulmonary valve, lying on the right.

parts.name: Right coronary artery
parts.zhDesc: 起自主動脈的右冠狀竇，沿右房室溝行走，供應右心房、右心室及部分左心室。
parts.enDesc: Arises from the right aortic sinus and runs in the right atrioventricular groove, supplying the right atrium, right ventricle and part of the left ventricle.

parts.node: Right inferolateral branch of right coronary artery
parts.name: Right inferolateral branch of right coronary artery
parts.zh: 右冠狀動脈右下外側支
parts.zhDesc: 右冠狀動脈沿心臟下緣、向心尖方向發出的分支。
parts.enDesc: A branch of the right coronary artery running along the inferior border of the heart towards the apex.

parts.name: Left coronary artery
parts.zhDesc: 起自主動脈的左冠狀竇，短幹之後分為前室間動脈與迴旋支。
parts.enDesc: Arises from the left aortic sinus; after a short main stem it divides into the anterior interventricular and circumflex arteries.

parts.name: Anterior interventricular artery
parts.zhDesc: 沿前室間溝向心尖下行，供應室間隔前部與左、右心室前壁。
parts.enDesc: Descends in the anterior interventricular groove towards the apex, supplying the anterior part of the interventricular septum and the anterior walls of both ventricles.

parts.node: Septal branches of anterior interventricular artery
parts.name: Septal branches of anterior interventricular artery
parts.zhDesc: 由前室間動脈穿入室間隔的分支，供應室間隔。
parts.enDesc: Branches of the anterior interventricular artery that penetrate the interventricular septum.

parts.name: Circumflex artery
parts.zhDesc: 左冠狀動脈的分支，沿左房室溝繞向心臟後方，供應左心房與左心室外側壁。
parts.enDesc: A branch of the left coronary artery that curves around the left atrioventricular groove to the back of the heart, supplying the left atrium and the lateral wall of the left ventricle.

parts.name: Great cardiac vein
parts.zhDesc: 伴隨前室間動脈上行，再沿左房室溝注入冠狀竇。
parts.enDesc: Ascends beside the anterior interventricular artery, then follows the left atrioventricular groove into the coronary sinus.

parts.name: Middle cardiac vein
parts.zhDesc: 沿後室間溝上行，注入冠狀竇。
parts.enDesc: Ascends in the posterior interventricular groove and drains into the coronary sinus.

parts.name: Inferior vein of left ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 收集左心室下壁的血液，注入冠狀竇或心大靜脈。
parts.enDesc: Drains the inferior wall of the left ventricle into the coronary sinus or the great cardiac vein.

parts.name: Posterior vein of left ventricle
parts.zhDesc: 收集左心室後壁的血液，注入冠狀竇。
parts.enDesc: Drains the posterior wall of the left ventricle into the coronary sinus.

parts.name: Coronary sinus
parts.zhDesc: 位於後方的左房室溝內，匯集心臟的靜脈血，開口於右心房。
parts.enDesc: Lies in the posterior atrioventricular groove, collects the cardiac veins and opens into the right atrium.

parts.name: Ascending aorta
parts.zhDesc: 由左心室經主動脈瓣發出，左、右冠狀動脈於其根部發出。
parts.enDesc: Leaves the left ventricle through the aortic valve; the left and right coronary arteries arise from its root.

parts.name: Aortic arch
parts.zhDesc: 升主動脈向後彎轉的一段，發出頭臂動脈幹、左總頸動脈與左鎖骨下動脈。
parts.enDesc: The curved continuation of the ascending aorta, giving off the brachiocephalic trunk, left common carotid and left subclavian arteries.

parts.name: Pulmonary trunk
parts.zhDesc: 由右心室經肺動脈瓣發出，向上分為左、右肺動脈。
parts.enDesc: Leaves the right ventricle through the pulmonary valve and divides into the left and right pulmonary arteries.

parts.name: Bifurcation of pulmonary trunk
parts.zhDesc: 肺動脈幹分為左、右肺動脈的部位。
parts.enDesc: The point where the pulmonary trunk divides into the left and right pulmonary arteries.

parts.name: Left pulmonary artery
parts.zhDesc: 將缺氧血送往左肺。
parts.enDesc: Carries deoxygenated blood to the left lung.

parts.name: Right pulmonary artery
parts.zhDesc: 將缺氧血送往右肺。
parts.enDesc: Carries deoxygenated blood to the right lung.

parts.name: Superior vena cava
parts.zhDesc: 收集頭頸、上肢與胸壁上部的缺氧血，向下開口於右心房的上部。
parts.enDesc: Collects deoxygenated blood from the head, neck, upper limbs and upper thoracic wall and opens into the upper part of the right atrium.

parts.name: Inferior vena cava
parts.zhDesc: 收集橫膈以下身體的缺氧血，穿過橫膈的腔靜脈孔，開口於右心房的下部。
parts.enDesc: Collects deoxygenated blood from the body below the diaphragm, passes through the caval opening of the diaphragm and opens into the lower part of the right atrium.

parts.name: Left superior pulmonary vein
parts.zhDesc: 將左肺上部的充氧血送入左心房。
parts.enDesc: Carries oxygenated blood from the upper part of the left lung to the left atrium.

parts.name: Left inferior pulmonary vein
parts.zhDesc: 將左肺下部的充氧血送入左心房。
parts.enDesc: Carries oxygenated blood from the lower part of the left lung to the left atrium.

parts.name: Right superior pulmonary vein
parts.zhDesc: 將右肺上、中部的充氧血送入左心房。
parts.enDesc: Carries oxygenated blood from the upper and middle parts of the right lung to the left atrium.

parts.name: Right inferior pulmonary vein
parts.zhDesc: 將右肺下部的充氧血送入左心房。
parts.enDesc: Carries oxygenated blood from the lower part of the right lung to the left atrium.

bodyparts3d.name: Anterior leaflet of right atrioventricular valve
bodyparts3d.zhDesc: 三尖瓣三片瓣葉中最大的一片，位於前方，以腱索連接前乳頭肌。
bodyparts3d.enDesc: The largest of the three leaflets of the tricuspid valve, lying anteriorly; its chordae tendineae attach to the anterior papillary muscle.

bodyparts3d.name: Anterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve
bodyparts3d.zhDesc: 二尖瓣的前瓣，較大，位於主動脈前庭旁，與左心室流出道相鄰。
bodyparts3d.enDesc: The larger, anterior leaflet of the mitral valve; it lies beside the aortic vestibule next to the left ventricular outflow tract.

bodyparts3d.name: Anterolateral papillary muscle of left ventricle
bodyparts3d.zhDesc: 左心室兩條乳頭肌之一，位於前外側壁，以腱索連接二尖瓣前、後兩片瓣葉。
bodyparts3d.enDesc: One of the two papillary muscles of the left ventricle, on the anterolateral wall; its chordae tendineae attach to both mitral leaflets.
